title: Full English Breakfast
description: A classic British breakfast dish featuring sausages, bacon, eggs, and more. Serve hot and enjoy with toast or hash browns.
instructions: 1. Preheat your grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Cook the sausages for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until browned and cooked through.
3. Cook the bacon in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
4. Fry the mushrooms in the same pan as the bacon until they release their moisture and start to brown.
5. Add the black pudding to the pan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
6. Crack the eggs into a separate pan over medium heat and cook until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked to your liking.
7. Toast some bread and serve with the sausages, bacon, eggs, mushrooms, black pudding, and tomatoes.
8. Serve the hash browns on the side, or use them as a base for your breakfast.
